Inspect Worker Function Closures, Globals, and Serialization Bundle Size

Source: R/globals.R
inspect_job_globals.Rd

Performs a pre-submission static and memory audit of a worker function fun, its lexical closure environment, explicit globals, packages, and optional args_list. Detects two common HPC failure modes before staging:

  1. Accidental closure bloat: A function defined inside another function silently captures large local objects (such as raw datasets >50 MB) in its enclosing frame, inflating payload.rds for every SLURM array task.

  2. Missing or unexported globals: Free variables or local helper functions referenced inside fun that are neither exported by packages nor explicitly listed in globals, which would fail on isolated cluster workers.

Usage

inspect_job_globals(
  fun,
  args_list = NULL,
  globals = list(),
  packages = character(),
  size_warn_mb = 50
)

Arguments

fun

Worker function fun(arg) to inspect.

args_list

Optional list of task arguments included in bundle size estimation.

globals

Optional named list of explicit worker globals.

packages

Character vector of packages declared for worker nodes.

size_warn_mb

Numeric threshold in MB above which captured closure objects or total estimated bundle size trigger a diagnostic warning. Default 50.

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_globals_report" containing:

  • ok: logical (TRUE when zero warnings are emitted).

  • warnings: character vector of actionable pre-submit warnings.

  • estimated_bundle_mb: total estimated serialization size in MB.

  • fun_size_mb, args_size_mb, globals_size_mb: component sizes in MB.

  • closure_objects: tibble of objects captured in non-global enclosing frames (name, class, size_mb, env_name).

  • globals_table: tibble of explicit globals (name, class, size_mb).

  • missing_variables: character vector of unresolved free variables.

  • unexported_functions: character vector of referenced functions not found in base/declared packages or globals.

See also

slurm_job_spec(), slurm_submit()

Examples

make_worker <- function() {
  local_offset <- 10
  function(x) x + local_offset
}
rep <- inspect_job_globals(make_worker(), args_list = as.list(1:5))
print(rep)
#> 
#> ── slurmpilot Pre-Submit Globals & Bundle Audit [OK] 
#> • Estimated payload size: 9.09 MB (closure=0.00 MB, globals=0.00 MB, args=0.00
#>   MB)
#> • Captured local closure objects: 4 | Explicit globals: 0
#> • Unresolved variables: 0 | Unexported functions: 0
